title: EVA-00, EVA-01 and EVA-02 on the runner
goal: The other three classes run on the same runner and the in-process EVA-02 executor is removed
acceptance: EVA-00 with no network and no writes outside its scratch space; EVA-01 with bounded egress and mounts; EVA-02 with the full grant
The scheduler no longer runs actions in process; the dead in-process path and its tests go
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-11 from the F-049 Check and the execution-boundaries assessment, after the owner asked why only F-049-T01 was planned. Later steps depend on T01/T03 findings; the owner may revise any split. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 3 h → 1.75 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept.
